description: Observatoire des devis photovoltaïques résidentiels en France (2026) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Scoresolaire. Independent Observatory of Residential Photovoltaics in France, published by ScoreSolaire. Live barometer, enriched as new quotes are analyzed (100 quotes from individuals to date). Coverage: Scoresolaire. The portal shows the English title as "Observatory of residential photovoltaic estimates in France (2026)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Scoresolaire. Its keywords include energie-solaire, renovation-energetique, donnees-ouvertes, observatoire, prix, panneaux-solaires. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, TXT, JSON. The listing shows 2026-08-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
